purpose: Register the next route after the measured generative-math collapse: teacher-generated verified-solution SFT, student-policy rejection-sampling KD, and their mixture, on GSM8K-train and MATH-train, with the verifier, sampling parameters, contamination discipline, seeds, evaluation protocol, win bar, sequencing and longer-budget plan fixed before any generation or training. This file changes no S42/S43/S44 registration and does not score the 20M bar.

full_bar.role: the 20M full-backbone CE+KL arm on the S43 math-weighted stream whose anchored score is the bar; the RFT full-backbone arms use the same active union and the same anchored instrument

math_stream_amendment.role: defines the S43 stream and contamination discipline; RFT uses the same train splits but a new accepted-solution stream, registered here

stage2b_corrective.role: defines the corrective residual, the token gate, the signed advantage and the preservation penalty; the 2M RFT corrective screen reuses that mechanism verbatim

s44_arm_table.role: the measured collapse this route answers: every trained arm below base on math; memory-2m -9.55 GSM8K / -6.20 MATH-500 points; held-out CE only +0.0203 nats

s45_collapse_diagnosis.role: the diagnostic target: on the correct solution path the memory residual adds +0.0373 nats/token over 80.0% of positions, first-10 +0.276 nats, total +13.220 nats over the five probed items; the gate is a near-constant 0.471 and the residual norm 0.768, with near-zero correlation to per-token damage. RFT must remove a persistent bias, not one bad token.

findings: memory-2m: 208 base-correct items become wrong and 82 wrong items become correct on GSM8K (net -126, -9.55 points); 203 of the 208 losses change the extracted final answer
every one of the 208 GSM8K losses diverges in the reasoning region, not at the final-answer marker; 40 first differ on a digit and 20 on an operator
the loss is length-dependent: -0.0270 in the shortest base-response quartile and -0.1295 / -0.1131 / -0.1131 in the next three
byte-identical responses are exactly score-neutral (100 items, delta +0.0000): all damage is in the items whose trajectory changed

on the correct teacher-forced path the memory residual adds +0.0373 nats/token over 80.0% of positions, +0.276 nats in the first 10 tokens and +13.220 nats total; the per-token rate is not growing, the sign is persistently positive
the memory gate is 0.471 mean |alpha| with a 0.36-0.50 range and the residual norm 0.768; neither correlates with per-token damage (Pearson near zero). A constant-magnitude residual is the problem
diagnosis_that_motivates_the_route.implication: verified-solution SFT is the direct counter-pressure: it raises the probability of the exact correct continuation tokens that the residual devalues, without asking the teacher KL to average over all tokens. On-policy KD is the control that the stage-2 route already measured; the mixture tests whether the two signals compose.

gsm8k.target: the last `####` value, extracted and normalised by the verifier

math.target: the last `\boxed{}` value, extracted and normalised by the verifier

data.reference_skips: a reference solution whose own answer cannot be extracted unambiguously is dropped before sampling and counted in the sampling receipt
data.no_test_split_in_training: only the train splits above are used; the contamination check below re-verifies against the test splits

policy.sft: teacher samples K solutions per prompt
policy.kd: student samples K solutions per prompt from the frozen base student (on-policy sampling, offline optimisation; see limits)
policy.both: one teacher pass and one student pass, each rejection-filtered, mixed 1:1 at the document level

teacher_sampling.seed_rule: torch.manual_seed(451 + prompt_index) per prompt; the generation job records the index-to-seed mapping
teacher_sampling.acceptance_rate: unmeasured until the generation job runs; the job writes verified/sampled, kept/verified and per-prompt verdict counts
teacher_sampling.device: generation job may use CUDA; S45 runs the verifier and the job's file path on CPU only, because the 20M bar occupies the GPU

verifier.definition: exactly one answer must be extractable; it is compared to the reference answer with exact numeric equality (1e-9 relative) or, if not numeric, exact canonical-string equality after the fixed LaTeX rewrite list
verifier.gsm8k_extraction: the last `#### value`; if no marker, the last number in the text (documented fallback)
verifier.math_extraction: the last balanced `\boxed{...}`; if none, the last `final answer is ...` phrase (documented fallback)
canonicalisation: remove braces around a single token (`\sqrt{2}` -> `\sqrt2`)
verifier.ambiguous: two distinct `####` answers, two distinct boxed answers, or a boxed alternative containing `or` is rejected, not resolved
verifier.not_symbolic: algebraically equal but differently written expressions are rejected; a false accept is worse than a false reject for this route

rejection_and_deduplication.deduplicate: within a prompt by whitespace-normalised solution text; the first verified occurrence in sample order is kept
rejection_and_deduplication.acceptance_arithmetic: verified_rate = verified/sampled; dedup_retention = kept/verified; prompts_with_a_kept_solution recorded
rejection_and_deduplication.stream_builder: scripts/s45_rft_stream.py; deterministic (input index, id, sample_index) order; whole cycles repeated until the token budget; epochs recorded; graft_tokens = 0

test_splits: openai/gsm8k test (1,319 rows, the anchored GSM8K basis)
contamination.method: 5-word shingle Jaccard on lowercased word sequences of prompt + solution against every test item
contamination.action: the sampling job writes the maximum Jaccard and the count at/above each threshold; any item at or above 0.5 fails the job closed; the stream builder carries the sampling receipt's report
contamination.why_also_needed: the splits are disjoint by construction, but the accepted solutions are teacher/student generations, so a memorised test item is still possible and must be checked

stage_a_2m_corrective_screen.substrate: corrective residual, 539,649 active elements, zero-init gate, frozen base
stage_a_2m_corrective_screen.purpose: cheap test of whether the diagnosis's persistent bias is removable before spending a 20M full-backbone run

rft-kd-signed-2m-corrective.objective: correction with the signed advantage, preserve_weight 0.5, interference_weight 0.05

rft-both-2m-corrective.data: 1:1 teacher verified solutions and student verified rollouts

stage_a_2m_corrective_screen.decision: an arm that does not beat base on the math family, or that loses held-out CE beyond its paired standard error, is not carried to stage B; the 2M screen is a filter, not a win

stage_b_20m_full_backbone.substrate: full text tower, tied embedding frozen, 498,113,344 trainable elements, the bar's active union
stage_b_20m_full_backbone.why_full: the win bar is the 20M full-backbone bar; a data/objective win at a smaller active union would not be comparable

rft-sft-20m-full.objective: sft (CE only, kl_weight 0); no teacher is loaded during training

rft-kd-20m-full.objective: ce_kl (CE + online teacher KL, kl_weight 0.5, T=2.0)

rft-both-20m-full.data: 1:1 teacher verified solutions and student verified rollouts
rft-both-20m-full.objective: ce_kl (CE + online teacher KL, kl_weight 0.5, T=2.0)

rft-sft-format-20m-full.data: teacher verified solutions with the target-side math-format curriculum (`prefix+steps`)
rft-sft-format-20m-full.status: registered ablation, launched only if rft-sft-20m-full wins its stage

common.optimizer: adam8bit (block 256, stochastic rounding), the bar's optimizer
common.why_bar_settings: the bar's optimizer and schedule are kept verbatim so a win or loss is attributable to the data and objective, not to a retune; a change is a new registration

terms_already_registered.base_preservation: corrective.corrective_objective's per-token `max(KL_student - KL_base, 0)` weighted by `sigmoid(-(a - mean a)/mean a)`
terms_already_registered.signed_advantage: `A_t = log p_T(y_t) - log p_B(y_t)` at T=1, bounded by `exp(clamp(A_t, -4, 4))`

new_option.name: math-format curriculum
new_option.eval_format_unchanged: the prompt is never edited; only the training solution text gets a `Solution:` prefix and/or `Step k:` line markers; the verifier is run after formatting and must still extract the same answer

objective_ablation_prep.registration_position: the 2M signed/preserved arm and the optional format arm are registered above before any score of them

seeds.evaluation: the anchored harness's own seeds (fewshot_seed 1234, random_seed 0, torch_seed 1234) and the S44 paired bootstrap seed 44

evaluation.instrument: scripts/s40_score.py through the anchored lm-evaluation-harness, transformers default attention (sdpa), the same basis as every stage-2 receipt
evaluation.basis: all 14,042 MMLU items, 504 MMLU-Pro, 1,319 GSM8K, 500 MATH-500 (amendment v2)
evaluation.heldout: the 2M-token held-out slice, 3,906 non-overlapping 512-token chunks, CE and KL(T=2.0) paired per chunk against base
evaluation.math_family: unweighted mean of GSM8K exact_match,strict-match and MATH-500 math_verify,none
evaluation.item_level: scripts/s44_arm_table.py pairs by (task, doc_id) only when the doc-hash sequences match; paired percentile bootstrap 95% CI and McNemar on discordant items; no family-mean-only comparison
evaluation.bar_scored_first: full-20m-math is scored before any RFT arm is scored, so the bar is a measured number

win_bar.statement: An RFT arm wins the route only if it beats BOTH the frozen base AND the full-20m-math bar on the math family, at equal tokens and equal active union (full-backbone arms), without buying the gain with a held-out or knowledge regression.
conditions_all_required: 1. math family mean exceeds base by more than the combined independent standard error, and the paired per-item bootstrap interval on the math tasks excludes zero in the same direction
2. math family mean exceeds full-20m-math's measured math family mean by more than the combined standard error, with the same paired requirement
3. held-out CE delta against base is not positive beyond its paired per-chunk standard error

4. neither registered harm mask shows a positive mean delta KL on the base-match tokens beyond its standard error, and the knowledge family mean is not below base by more than the combined standard error
win_bar.2m_screen_bar: a stage-A arm must beat base on the math family by more than the combined standard error and must not lose held-out CE beyond its paired standard error; it is then carried to stage B, but the 2M score is not the route win
win_bar.no_softening: a gain on MMLU or MMLU-Pro alone, or a family-mean tie, is not a win

decision_rule: 1. Score full-20m-math first. If it has no anchored receipt, no RFT arm is compared to it.
2. Run the four stage-A 2M corrective arms in the registered order; stop after the first that satisfies the 2M screen bar and record the other three as measured or not-run with the reason.
3. If a stage-A arm beats base but not its held-out condition, the 2M route is a partial and stage B is not launched without a new registration.
4. If a stage-A arm satisfies the screen, run the three stage-B 20M full arms in the order sft, kd, both; score each on the anchored harness and the held-out slice.
5. If one stage-B arm satisfies every win-bar condition, adopt it and extend it to 60M and 100M with the checkpoint plan below; the format-curriculum arm is launched only after that win.
6. If no stage-B arm beats the bar but one beats base, report a data-route partial (the full bar still wins on math) and do not spend the 60M/100M budget without a new registered mechanism.
7. If no stage-B arm beats base, the RFT/on-policy route is a null at 20M on this data; the next route is the registered scoreboard route, not another unregistered retune.

longer_budget_plan.rate_basis: median of the last 50 log lines of full-20m-math (tokens_per_second); the last line was 1836.0 at step 1446

checkpoint_plan.why: one 100M run with checkpoints at 20/40/60/100M lets a single run draw the whole curve instead of four separate runs; the 60M run is the cheaper first extension

longer_budget_plan.checkpoint_storage: measured checkpoint 2,008,524,311 bytes; 60M milestones 5.61 GiB, 100M milestones 7.48 GiB; with the newest/latest copy 7.48 / 9.35 GiB
longer_budget_plan.sampling_bound: one teacher pass over both train splits is at most 61,329,408 generated tokens (14,973 x 8 x 512); the acceptance rate and the realised token count are the generation job's measurement
longer_budget_plan.kdp_note: the 60M/100M extension uses the winning stage-B stream; the sampling pass is re-run only if the winning arm used a different policy, and the recomputed acceptance rate is receipted

sequencing.why_sequential: one GPU; the memory accounting forbids two memory-heavy jobs at once
sequencing.early_stop: if the 2M screen has no arm above its bar, stage B is not launched and the reason is receipted
sequencing.bar_first: the bar run is in flight at registration and must be scored before any 20M RFT score is compared

stage_a_2m_corrective.basis: the stage-2b corrective shape measured 9.211 GiB allocated / 9.363 GiB reserved; 12.5 GiB is the stage-2b limit, and the 2M screen uses the same shape

stage_b_20m_full.basis: the bar's full arm measured 11.429 GiB allocated / 11.672 GiB reserved at 12.5 GiB; SFT loads no teacher and KD loads the same teacher as the bar, so the limit is unchanged
stage_b_20m_full.smoke_required: each stage-B arm runs its own 20-step smoke and records the GPU peak before launch; a higher peak is a new amendment, not a silent limit change

container.sizing_rule: SELVEDGE_MEM = 1.5x the arm's own smoke cgroup peak, never below measured + 1 GiB
container.bar_reference: the bar's smoke measured 6.449 GiB cgroup peak and launched at 10 GiB (1.55x)
container.generation: the generation job's teacher-only or teacher+student shape is smoked first; its limit is derived from that peak, not from the bar's

sizing.reservation: before each launch, host MemAvailable must exceed the new container's limit plus 4 GiB; no second memory-heavy job starts while the bar unit is active

what_this_file_does_not_establish: that any acceptance rate, kept-solution count or realised token count is known: the generation pass has not run
that 20M verified-solution tokens are enough to move GSM8K: this is the experiment
that verified-solution SFT removes the measured persistent bias: the 2M screen is the test
that student-policy sampling is fully on-policy: the rollouts are sampled once and optimised offline, not re-sampled during training; a fully online variant is a separate registration
that the canonical-string verifier is symbolic: algebraically equal but differently written MATH answers are rejected
that the format curriculum helps: it is a registered ablation, not a default
that the bar has been scored: full-20m-math is in flight and has no anchored receipt at registration
